name: http-server
body: HTTP server: binds 127.0.0.1 only; default port 8080 with automatic fallback through 8081..8099 (20 ports total) when busy, then a startup error advising `--port` if all are busy; an explicit `--port` that is busy is a startup error (no fallback); reports the actual bound port for the printed link. Serves deck page or error page, embedded assets, deck assets/, /templates gallery and the live-reload endpoint, which pushes each deck-rebuilt notification to connected browsers.
